title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Credit Line Review Desk Note
content:
**Subject.** A credit line increase on a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account that meets every test of the card's credit line increase terms is sized at the line review. The line review governs one result: the new credit line of the account.

**Governing clause.** The new credit line is worked out only after the foreign purchase against which the account's most recently posted foreign transaction fee was assessed, when it posted to the account twice, carries an open duplicate-charge dispute on its posting in error.

Read as a state of the account's records: while that foreign purchase has posted twice and its posting in error carries no open duplicate-charge dispute, the new credit line is not yet worked out. When that purchase did not post twice, the clause sets no condition.

**Observable effect.** Once recorded, the account's credit line is the new credit line and today's date is the date the credit line last changed; the account status, balance, card number and AutoPay do not change, and the cardmember can spend up to the new line at once.

## Tool card: `raise_credit_line_b8050b6c`

**Capability.** Raises the credit line of one Marlowe & Finch card account on a credit line review: the account's credit line is set to the new amount given and today's date is recorded as the date the credit line last changed. The account status, balance, card number and AutoPay do not change; the status given is only confirmed on the receipt.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `raise_credit_line_b8050b6c` and then calls it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `card_account_id` | the card account number of the account whose line is raised, as returned by the card account lookup for the verified customer | identifier |
| `status` | the account status shown by the card account lookup, confirmed on the receipt | one of `applied` (the application still awaits the credit decision), `active` (open with charging privileges), `restricted` (charging privileges suspended for missed minimum payments), `closed` (closed by the cardmember), `charged_off` (charged off and placed with recovery), `declined` (the application was declined) |
| `new_credit_limit` | the full new credit line of the account, not the increase | USD, 2 decimal places, a positive amount with no currency sign |

**Return.** A dictionary receipt: `status` is `credit_line_changed` when the change is recorded; `card_account_id` is the account number changed; `status_confirmed` is the account status given, as confirmed on the receipt; `previous_credit_limit` and `credit_limit` are the line before and after the change in USD with 2 decimal places; `change_date` is the effective date in YYYY-MM-DD.

## Basis Q&A

**Is the amount passed the increase or the new line?** The full new credit line, in USD with 2 decimal places.

**What date does the account show afterwards as its last credit line change?** The date the change is recorded, which the receipt returns as the change date.
